# Implementation Plan: Tjenestemodul M01

**Branch**: `001-tjenestemodul-m01` | **Date**: 2026-04-13 | **Spec**: [spec.md](spec.md)
**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/001-tjenestemodul-m01/spec.md`

**Note**: This plan was generated by the `/speckit-plan` command.

## Summary

Build the Tjenestemodul M01 — a read-only service that ingests child placement (Tiltak) data from BiRK via CDC (Event Hubs/Debezium), exposes a GraphQL API for case workers to view placement history, and provides an internal REST lookup endpoint for Hendelsestjenesten. Async child linkage resolves `BarnId` from Personmodulen via `BarnRegistrert` events. All event publishing uses a transactional outbox to guarantee delivery.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: C# 14 / .NET 10
**Primary Dependencies**:
- Hot Chocolate 15 (GraphQL API, code-first, `AddTypes()` assembly scanning)
- EF Core 10 + Azure SQL (domain + staging schemas, UUID v4 PKs, soft-delete interceptors)
- Azure.Messaging.ServiceBus (outbox publishing, `BarnRegistrert` subscription, `LeseloggHendelse`, `TjenesteOpprettet`)
- Azure.Messaging.EventHubs.Processor (`EventProcessorClient` for BiRK CDC stream, Blob Storage checkpoints)
- Microsoft.Identity.Web (Azure EntraID JWT bearer + managed identity for system-to-system calls)
- Wolverine (transactional outbox — Service Bus publishing atomically with SQL writes, GL-33)
- Polly v8 / Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience (exponential backoff for Personmodulen HTTP calls)
- Serilog (structured logging with `correlation_id` enrichment, PS-08)

**Storage**: Azure SQL — two schemas: `birk_staging` (BiRK field names preserved; adapter-layer only) and `tjeneste` (domain model; BiRK-agnostic)
**Testing**: xUnit + FluentAssertions + Testcontainers.MsSql + Testcontainers.ServiceBus + WebApplicationFactory
**Target Platform**: Azure (containerized, AKS or App Service), Azure VNet / Private Endpoints (PS-03)
**Project Type**: Web service — GraphQL endpoint + background event consumers (hosted services)
**Performance Goals**: Placement history query < 500 ms (FR-001); BiRK change visible within 1–2 min (SC-002); child linkage within 1–2 min of `BarnRegistrert` (SC-004)
**Constraints**: No pagination in M01 (FR-001 note); stateless (PS-09); no hard deletes (PP-05); no write operations via API (MP-01)
**Scale/Scope**: Single module in the M2LB platform; BiRK tables: orders, service types, status types, termination reasons, placements

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-check after Phase 1 design.*

| # | Principle / Standard | Status | Notes |
|---|----------------------|--------|-------|
| PP-01 | Contract-Driven Communication | ✓ PASS | Hot Chocolate schema is the only published contract; no direct data layer access from outside |
| PP-02 | Centralised Access Decision | ✓ PASS | Every resolver and internal endpoint calls Autorisasjonsmodulen eval API (GL-08); no local access rules |
| PP-03 | Immutable Audit Trail | ✓ PASS | Outbox pattern (GL-33) publishes `LeseloggHendelse` after every read (GL-32); consumed by Revisjonstjenesten |
| PP-04 | Security Classification | ✓ PASS | Classification evaluated inside the authorisation call — never as a post-hoc filter on query results |
| PP-05 | Data Has Legal History | ✓ PASS | Placements are never deleted — status transitions only; `BarnLinkageStatus` is write-once (FR-018) |
| PP-06 | Service Autonomy | ✓ PASS | Own Azure SQL database; no direct access to other services' data layers |
| PP-07 | Business Logic in Domain | ✓ PASS | Linkage logic, status rules, and sort logic live in `M2LB.Tjeneste.Domain` |
| PP-08 | Domain Language in Contracts | ✓ PASS | BiRK field names confined to `birk_staging` schema and field-mapping config (MP-03). Exception: `TjenesteOpprettet` carries `BirkTiltakKey` as a technical correlator for Hendelsestjenesten — required by spec (Key Entities section); does not appear in any user-facing contract |
| PP-09 | Spec and Tests Inseparable | ✓ PASS | All 5 user stories have acceptance scenarios; each scenario maps to an automated test |
| MP-01 | Read-Only in M01 | ✓ PASS | GraphQL exposes queries only; no mutations on `Tjeneste`; all data flows in from BiRK |
| MP-02 | Data Minimisation | ✓ PASS | Whitelist config in integration adapter (FR-008); only listed fields written to `birk_staging` |
| MP-03 | BiRK Terminology Does Not Leak | ✓ PASS | Field-name translation in Infrastructure adapter before domain schema; `BirkTiltakKey` stored in domain only as a secondary key, never exposed in GraphQL |
| MP-04 | Loose Coupling to Personmodulen | ✓ PASS | `BarnId` is a nullable `Guid`; no FK enforced; classification decisions delegated to Autorisasjonsmodulen |
| MP-05 | Integration Layer + Domain Phase Out Together | ✓ PASS | All BiRK adapter code in `M2LB.Tjeneste.Infrastructure`; domain project has no BiRK imports |
| PS-01 | Azure EntraID | ✓ PASS | `Microsoft.Identity.Web` JWT bearer; audiences validated on all endpoints |
| PS-02 | Managed Identities | ✓ PASS | Service Bus and Event Hubs via `DefaultAzureCredential`; no stored secrets |
| PS-03 | VNet / Private Endpoints | ✓ PASS | Deployment concern; no public IPs; noted in quickstart |
| PS-04 | UUID v4 | ✓ PASS | All domain entity PKs are `Guid`; BiRK keys are secondary references in Infrastructure only |
| PS-05 | Service Bus + Event Hubs | ✓ PASS | Event Hubs for BiRK CDC; Service Bus for domain events and outbox relay |
| PS-06 | Operations Registration at Startup | ✓ PASS | FR-027: `IHostedService` publishes `Tjeneste:HentTjenesterForBarn` and `Tjeneste:HentTjeneste` to shared registration queue |
| PS-07 | URL-Path Versioning | ✓ PASS | Internal REST endpoint: `GET /v1/internal/tiltak/{key}`; health: `/health`; GraphQL at `/graphql` (schema-first evolution, no URL versioning needed) |
| PS-08 | Health Check + Structured Logging | ✓ PASS | FR-024–FR-026; Serilog with `correlation_id` enrichment; `Microsoft.Extensions.Diagnostics.HealthChecks` |
| PS-09 | Stateless | ✓ PASS | All state in Azure SQL; no in-process caches between requests |
| GL-08 | Call Authorisation Eval API | ✓ PASS | Custom Hot Chocolate middleware calls Autorisasjonsmodulen before every protected resolver |
| GL-09 | Register Operations at Startup | ✓ PASS | `OperationsRegistrationService` publishes `Tjeneste:HentTjenesterForBarn` and `Tjeneste:HentTjeneste` |
| GL-10 | Security Classification + Audit Trail | ✓ PASS | Classification gate in auth eval call; outbox publishes `LeseloggHendelse` after every read |
| GL-19 | Adapter Layer Absorbs BiRK Complexity | ✓ PASS | All BiRK mapping, filtering, and name translation in Infrastructure; domain has no BiRK concepts |
| GL-22 | Idempotent Event Consumers | ✓ PASS | `BarnRegistrert`: already-linked placements → silent no-op (FR-015); CDC writes: upsert by `BirkTiltakKey` (FR-012) |
| GL-32 | Read-Log for `barnId` Reads | ✓ PASS | Outbox event after every case worker query; metadata-only, no PII (FR-006a) |
| GL-33 | Outbox Pattern for Service Bus | ✓ PASS | Wolverine transactional outbox: SQL write + event enqueue in a single transaction |

**Post-design re-check**: No violations. All gates pass.

**Structure Decision**: Three-project solution (`Api`, `Domain`, `Infrastructure`) as mandated by the module constitution. `Api` contains Hot Chocolate types and the minimal API internal lookup handler. `Domain` is pure business logic with no infrastructure dependencies. `Infrastructure` contains all BiRK adapter code, EF Core contexts, and messaging consumers.
